personality_one_liner: A high-performance dark tactical utility command center built for Indian ride-hailing drivers to monitor and evaluate live requests instantly.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding with compact tactical widgets for quick glanceability while parked or moving.

do's: Use high contrast tonal surfaces and clear dividers for maximum clarity in dark environments
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs that impair glanceability in bright sunlight or dark night driving

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Monitor service status, connected platforms, daily detection metrics, and Start/Stop monitoring toggle.

states.loading: Centered dark spinner with tactical amber status indicator
states.empty: No detection activity today. Tap Start Monitoring or Simulation Mode to begin.
states.error: Notification access listener disconnected. Tap Retry to rebind.

screens.layout: Sticky header with service status pill, quick toggle master switch card, live metrics 2x2 grid, active platforms status list, and recent requests ticker.

screens.name: Platforms
screens.purpose: Configure per-platform integration for Rapido, Uber, and Ola with permission status and automation controls.

states.loading: Skeleton card stack matching platform rows
states.error: Failed to query system accessibility services.

screens.layout: Vertical stack of platform cards with installed status badge, notification permission toggle, category selector, and independent auto-accept switch.

screens.name: Rules
screens.purpose: Edit filter criteria including minimum fare, max pickup distance, fare-per-km, and operating hours.

states.error: Validation error in rule parameter fields.

screens.layout: Grouped settings sections with sliders, number steppers, operating hour selectors, and sticky Reset-to-Default / Save bar.

screens.name: Live Requests
screens.purpose: Inspect incoming ride requests with real-time confidence scores, rule evaluations, and manual response actions.

states.empty: No active ride requests detected. Enable Simulation Mode in header to test feed.
states.error: Stream parsing failed. Last raw payload logged.

screens.layout: Top simulation mode bar, live filter chips, and vertical list of request cards with platform badge, fare, distances, state pill, and Accept/Dismiss actions.

screens.name: History & Diags
screens.purpose: Review detection history, rule decision explanations, OCR confidence, and export redacted logs.
screens.layout: Search/filter header bar followed by chronological event list with expandable rule match breakdown, latency counters, and export button.

rapido_logo.alt: Rapido Captain delivery and ride service

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK) with warm amber-orange accent (#FF6B00) and deep obsidian surface (#121418).
Implement Indian ride-hailing context (₹ and kilometres, Rapido, Uber Driver, Ola Driver).
Include an interactive Simulation Mode toggle at the top of Live Requests and Dashboard to feed test ride requests through the pipeline in the preview.
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt, text sizes follow the strict token scale, and weight cap is 500 max (except display titles where bold is permitted by Barlow Condensed).
Implement Loading, Empty, and Error states on every screen with full height container.
Never display a ride as accepted unless confirmed by reliable evidence; use explicit manual verification prompts for unconfirmed states.
